notes: typing is dynamic (Python); optional static typing via type hints and django-stubs/mypy exists but is not enforced by the framework. learning_curve is high because it's evaluated against a JS-only baseline — a developer must learn Python and Django's ORM/MTV conventions in addition to DRF's serializers and viewsets. operational_complexity and horizontal_scaling assume standard managed hosting for Django (e.g. Render, Heroku) running behind gunicorn/uWSGI — no built-in autoscaling.
